Owen thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Owen borrowed a book about music from the supermarket. Leo is interested in dancing. The grocer sells fresh fruit at the street corner.
Owen learned a lot about music. The school gate is one of the best places in the city. Life is full of small surprises. The textbook has colourful pictures.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the school gate by bike. Owen hopes to visit Toronto one day. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. My brother goes to college in Shanghai.
The weather was windy that day. Owen is going to travel to Toronto in May. Owen likes windy days best.
